newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France not yet chosen wide-body plane.
newsitem.headline: Air France not yet chosen wide-body plane.

text.p: Air France has not yet decided which type of wide-bodied, long-haul aircraft that it will need in the coming years, a source close to the airline said on Monday.

The source was speaking after a French newsletter, La Lettre de l'Expansion, said that Air France had chosen Boeing 777-300 aircraft equipped with General Electric GE 90-100B engines over the Airbus A-340.
"For the moment, we are looking at the A-340 and the Boeing 777 which could be needed for our wide-body, long-haul fleet in the coming years. Air France has not yet made its choice," said the source.
